evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the postcondition that reporting responsibility is retained by the originating unit after successful transmission of an emergency-related report (which may include J3.1 as part of broader EW reporting context).

evidence_cards.content: It is illegal to assume reporting responsibility for another unit's J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Reinforces the postcondition that no transfer of reporting authority occurs unless explicitly permitted — critical for system state integrity after report initiation.

evidence_cards.content: Each unit initiating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report shall assign a TN not known to be in use on the interface even if it is believed that such a report may concern the same emitter currently being reported in another J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report by another unit.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a mandatory post-transmission system state: unique TN assignment per originating unit, ensuring track number uniqueness and avoiding collision in multi-unit environments — directly affects system state after successful report.

evidence_cards.content: The exception is a unit originating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report on a Fix, AOP, or LOB currently reported by the same unit or received from another unit in a J14.0 message shall assign the same TN, Reference in the J3.7 message as contained in the J14.0 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the only allowed deviation from unique TN assignment — when re-reporting own data or inheriting via J14.0 — which defines a constrained postcondition for TN reuse, affecting system state consistency.
